name: settings-page
title: Settings page
description: Settings as the console draws it: one title and its parts as line tabs, switching in place, each part the settings table. General: the company's name to edit in place, its ID and when it joined, then Sign out. Members: who is in, with Invite members. Sign-in: each way in with its switch.

'use client' import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from 'react' import { Pencil } from 'lucide-react' import { ConsolePage } from '@/components/product/ConsolePage' import { Button } from '@/components/ui/Button' import { CopyText } from '@/components/ui/CopyText' import { Input } from '@/components/ui/Input' import { LineTabs } from '@/components/ui/LineTabs' import { PixelButton } from '@/components/ui/PixelButton' import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/Switch' import { Table } from '@/components/ui/Table' import { Tag } from '@/components/ui/Tag' import { useControllable } from '@/hooks/useControllable' // Settings (pages/dashboard/settings, SettingsFrame take 3): one title and its parts as line tabs under it, switching // in place. Every part is the settings table, so a tab changes what it says and not how it looks. General: the // company's name (Edit opens it in place: Save, Cancel or Escape), its ID to copy and when it joined, then who is // signed in and Sign out. Members: who is in, their role and when they joined, with Invite members, the page's one // dark button, on the tabs' row. Sign-in: each way in with its switch. It calls nothing: rename, invite, remove, // toggle and sign-out are callbacks; `part` is the open tab (Vue's v-model:part). export type SettingsPart = 'general' | 'members' | 'sign-in' export type SettingsMember = { email: string, role: string, joined: string, invited?: boolean } export type SignInOption = { id: string, label: string, description: string, on: boolean } export interface SettingsPageProps { company: { name: string, id: string, joined: string } members: SettingsMember[] signIn: SignInOption[] email: string part?: SettingsPart defaultPart?: SettingsPart onPartChange?: (part: SettingsPart) => void onRename?: (name: string) => void onInvite?: () => void onRemove?: (member: SettingsMember) => void onToggle?: (id: string, on: boolean) => void onSignOut?: () => void } const PARTS: { value: SettingsPart, label: string }[] = [{ value: 'general', label: 'General' }, { value: 'members', label: 'Members' }, { value: 'sign-in', label: 'Sign-in' }] export function SettingsPage({ company, members, signIn, email, part: partValue, defaultPart = 'general', onPartChange, onRename, onInvite, onRemove, onToggle, onSignOut }: SettingsPageProps) { const [part, setPart] = useControllable(partValue, defaultPart, onPartChange) const uid = useId() const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false) const [draft, setDraft] = useState('') const focusNext = useRef(false) useEffect(() => { if (editing && focusNext.current) { focusNext.current = false document.getElementById(`${uid}-rename`)?.focus() } }, [editing, uid]) function edit() { setDraft(company.name) focusNext.current = true setEditing(true) } function save() { const name = draft.trim() if (!name) return setEditing(false) onRename?.(name) } return (
